h1: Cagrilintide with tirzepatide: what has and has not been tested
dek: No human trial has given cagrilintide with tirzepatide. Tirzepatide has only been CagriSema's comparator; the only shared study was in rats.
scope: Informational only. Combination dosage queries answered with the absence of trials and each drug's own doses separately; no vendor or blend sourcing.
verification_2026-10-29: Europe PMC search ABSTRACT:cagrilintide AND ABSTRACT:tirzepatide (31 hits): no human trial of the pair; one rat study (PMID 42744908). Registry search via web: CagriSema vs tirzepatide trials only (NCT06131437 and a type 2 diabetes trial). ClinicalTrials.gov API not reachable from this environment.

competitors.gap: Gives 'recommended dosage guidelines' for the pair and claims a 'dedicated large-scale cagrilintide-plus-tirzepatide phase 3 trial is still ongoing'; no such trial exists. Omits REDEFINE 4 and REIMAGINE 5.
Seller page that frames cagrilintide as a 'satiety finisher' for people on tirzepatide, with no evidence for the pairing.
Tirzepatide-only dosing guide; nothing on amylin drugs or the cagrilintide head-to-head trials.
Clinic page on a different untested pairing; connection failed on fetch.
Registry mirror of REDEFINE 4 design without results.

information_gain: States, with the search trail, that no human cagrilintide plus tirzepatide trial exists, and supplies the nearest real evidence no competitor has: the 2026 rat comparator study, the EloraTZP phase 2 result with its 10.8% to 27.0% discontinuations, and both REDEFINE 4 and REIMAGINE 5 head-to-head results.
serp_format_rewarded: AI Overview and image pack; a direct yes/no answer up top, a comparison table, and short FAQ answers.
